Name: Craftable Coffee Maker
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Have you ever wanted to start a coffee empire but really REALLY didn't want to worry about brewing it all? Maybe you just wanted to decorate with the coffee maker but were sad that you could only get one. Whatever your reasoning for desiring more than one, I've got you! Now you can craft as many as your little heart desires! 

You have to have completed the "Gifts for George" special order, and have read the mail that Evelyn sends you, in order to craft more. 

The recipe is pretty simple:

- 5 Hardwood
- 1 Refined Quartz
- 1 Gold Bar
- 5 Coffee Beans

Now be free! Start your Coffee Empire today!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
